title: Australian Barbeque Pie
description: A midnight-craving, jammy and gooey Australian dish featuring barbeque sauce and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the pie crust into a 9-inch pie dish and trim the edges.
In a large skillet, caramelize the onions over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped mushrooms to the skillet and continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine the vegetarian barbeque sauce, namul, soy sauce, and balsamic vinegar.
Pour the sauce mixture into the pie crust and spread it evenly.
Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella and bread crumbs on top of the sauce mixture.
Place the pie in the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly and slightly caramelized.
Remove the pie from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro and black pepper.
Let the pie cool for a few minutes before serving.
